cases.name: TS: the flag gates the floor again, as it used to
cases.old:
if (this.#watermark === undefined) return undefined;
    return { atLeast: this.#watermark.toString() };
cases.new:
if (!this.#monotonic || this.#watermark === undefined) return undefined;
    return { atLeast: this.#watermark.toString() };
caught_by: a session that has written sends a freshness floor, monotonic or not

cases.name: TS: a read's view is folded in even with the flag off
cases.old:
if (!this.#monotonic) return;
    if (!servedBy || typeof servedBy !== "object") return;
caught_by: a read does not advance a non-monotonic session's watermark
